questions.prompt: In how many ways can 5 distinct books be arranged in a row?
questions.explanation: The number of arrangements of 5 distinct items is 5 factorial = 5 x 4 x 3 x 2 x 1 = 120.

questions.prompt: In how many ways can 2 people be chosen from a group of 5?
questions.explanation: Order does not matter, so this is a combination: 5 choose 2 = (5 x 4) / (2 x 1) = 10.

questions.prompt: When two fair dice are rolled, what is the probability that the sum is 7?
questions.explanation: There are 6 favourable pairs summing to 7 out of 36 equally likely outcomes, so 6/36 = 1/6. Seven is the most likely dice sum.

questions.prompt: A bag has 3 red and 2 blue balls. What is the probability of drawing a red ball at random?
questions.explanation: There are 3 red out of 5 balls total, so the probability is 3/5.

questions.prompt: How many distinct 3-letter arrangements can be made from the letters of the word CAT (all letters different)?
questions.explanation: Three distinct letters can be arranged in 3 factorial = 6 ways.
